content: <thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 194.086 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈193.079 Da. The isotopic pattern (significant M+2 peak ~33 % of the base) is characteristic of two chlorine atoms (Cl‑35/Cl‑37). Accounting for two Cl atoms (2 × 34.969 Da) leaves ≈123.14 Da for C, H, and O. The composition that best matches this residual mass is C₈H₁₁OCl₂ (exact monoisotopic mass = 193.019 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore, the molecular formula is: C8H11OCl2.
